ov: The smallest bear, from the tropical forests of Southeast Asia, named for the orange to cream patch on its chest. It is the most tree-dwelling of all bears, sleeping and sunbathing 2 to 7 m up, and is mainly active during the day.
df: Ants, bees, beetles, honey and termites, plus seeds and many kinds of fruit.
fx: It is also called the honey bear, and tears open hollow trees to reach wild bees and their honey.
Its population is thought to have fallen by 35% since the 1990s.
